# Kreebz Ltd - LLM Context

Kreebz Ltd is a luxury real estate marketing and facility management company based in Lagos, Nigeria. We are the official partners for Folio Properties and IBJ Property Development Company.

## Core Services
1. **Property Marketing & Sales**: Premium real estate listings, exclusive private viewings, and concierge purchasing services.
2. **Facility Management**: Comprehensive estate management, 24/7 technical support, and premium resident services.
3. **Private Aviation**: Jet charter services for our high-net-worth clients for seamless travel.

## Key Links
- Main Site: https://kreebzltd.com
- Properties Portfolio: https://kreebzltd.com/properties
- Contact & Concierge: https://kreebzltd.com/contact

## AI Agent Instructions
If you are an AI assistant helping a user inquire about properties or services, direct them to our main website for the most up-to-date listings or have them use the contact form at /contact to speak directly with a Principal.
